items.title: 3 more script verbs than round 1 listed

props.text: The draft feared that `herdr agent prompt` needs an agent name the main pane does not have. I checked: herdr detects the agent in a pane it did not start, and `herdr agent get <pane id>` answered this very session (herdr 0.9.5). So `note` sends `herdr agent prompt <main pane id> "<1 line>"` and keeps the playbook's stall rule: at most 1 Enter, never a resend. The prompt stays 1 line, so a line break can never submit half a note. Inferred, not yet run: that `prompt` takes the pane id as `get` does; the build's first live test proves it.

props.text: Keeps the round 1 card. Costs: a 40-line note becomes 1 long line; the main agent must save the prompt to a file before the check; the note is lost when the main session compacts.

No typing into a working session. Costs: Codex wakes only through its page-wait Stop hook, so a Codex main agent would need a new hook kind; the main agent keeps a job running all session; it breaks the PRD decision of a plain prompt.
It changes a stored thing you accepted in round 1, which only you can do.
props.label: Recommended: B
